threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts local and synced files and steals client data, including Client A's SSI records and subcontractor W-9s
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily work as administrator; reused passwords; no offline encrypted backup; synced folders carry encrypted files to the cloud; no training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 laptop; SYS-01 files; BP-02; BP-03
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.9(a)(1); 1520.9(c); C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.6; s.13); Fla. Stat. 501.171(4)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus; 30-day file version history
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; password manager; encrypted offline backup rotated weekly; annual training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Phishing or session-token theft takes over the productivity suite account despite MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily account is the tenant administrator; no review of sign-ins; MFA prompts approved on one phone
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.2); 49 CFR 1520.9(a)(1)
treatment_plan: Separate admin account with a hardware key; monthly sign-in review; number-matching MFA prompts

threat_event: Client A SSI records are disclosed to a person without a need to know through the shared project folder or the unlocked paper copy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI kept in the general Client A folder shared with the GIS subcontractor; printed copy in an unlocked drawer; no SSI procedure
existing_controls: Subcontractor share removed 2026-08-13; activity log shows no open of the SSI files; Client A informed TSA 2026-08-14
treatment_plan: Separate SSI folder shared with no one; paper copy in a locked cabinet or shredded; mark derived drafts; written SSI rules in POL-01

threat_event: The unencrypted USB backup drive is lost or stolen, exposing client data from several projects and SSI copies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drive unencrypted; kept in an unlocked drawer; sometimes carried to client sites to hand over files
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.9(a)(1); C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.3)
treatment_plan: Replace with a hardware-encrypted drive; wipe and destroy the old drive with a record; never carry the backup drive off site

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting SaaS exposes subcontractor Social Security numbers and allows fake bank-detail changes on invoices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password only; the password is reused on other sites
treatment_plan: MFA on; unique passphrase in a password manager; tell clients that bank details never change by email

threat_event: Client A data uploaded to an unapproved AI service is kept or used for model training, breaching the Client A addendum
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free-trial click-through terms; no client approval; no AI rules
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 AI tool; Client A historian exports
treatment_plan: No further use; written deletion request; follow Client A's instructions; approval rule in POL-01 9.5 (P10)

threat_event: A subcontractor's personal laptop or email is compromised and client files sent by anyone-with-the-link shares are taken
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Anonymous share links; personal email; unknown device security; no security terms
treatment_plan: Named external accounts only; short subcontractor security terms; Client A written approval of each subcontractor; share only extracts needed for the task

threat_event: An incident is not reported to Client A within 24 hours or released SSI is not reported to TSA, so the client cannot act and the contract is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan; owner unaware of the 24-hour term and 1520.9(c)
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.9(c); C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.6); Fla. Stat. 501.171(4)
treatment_plan: Adopt P08 with printed contacts; walkthrough; contacts in the phone

threat_event: Client data from finished projects is found during a Client A review or exposed in a later incident, after the contract said it would be destroyed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No return-or-destroy step at project end; copies in cloud and on USB
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.7); 49 CFR 1520.19(b)
treatment_plan: Return or destroy old project data; send certificates; project close-out checklist in POL-01 8.8

threat_event: The engineer-owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so urgent findings do not reach clients and deadlines are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role, credential, and MFA prompt; no backup engineer
treatment_plan: Peer engineer arrangement approved by clients; sealed recovery codes; second MFA key; escalation path given to clients (P05)

threat_event: An attacker or infected household device on the home network attacks the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Household devices on the same network; factory router password
existing_controls: Laptop host firewall; SaaS traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: New router password; household devices on the guest network; router firmware updates

threat_event: An AI anomaly-screening output misses a leak signature or misranks an anomaly and the error reaches a client recommendation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation of the tool; trial outputs not compared with known events
existing_controls: Owner reviews all data independently; trial outputs were not used in any deliverable
treatment_plan: Any future tool is validated on known cases first; outputs advisory only; owner signs every finding (P10)

threat_event: Client A finds that questionnaire answers were not true and ends or does not renew the contract
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 answer claimed a written incident plan that did not exist
existing_controls: Owner told Client A about the gaps on 2026-08-14
treatment_plan: Answer the 2026 questionnaire from these deliverables only; attach the POA&M summary

threat_event: A hurricane or long power cut closes the home office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single location; paper and devices at home
existing_controls: Cloud files reachable from anywhere; phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Move the laptop and encrypted backup to a safe location when a hurricane watch is issued

threat_event: The productivity suite provider has an outage longer than one working day
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); client portals hold the source data
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep working copies of active project files on the encrypted laptop
